== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His role model is [[Nuguri]].
* He is good friends with [[Zeka (Kim Geon-woo)|Zeka]].<ref>[https://youtu.be/3m8Dk2nerfc?si=sQorxsMAjGR9fBnX&t=328] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* The first player to get his own prestige skin.
* His name Kingen comes from the japanese word 謹厳 meaning 'stern'.
* His MBTI is ESTJ.<ref>[https://youtu.be/byLHbKv489U?t=27 킹겐의 50문 50답] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* He is a fan of Korean-American K-Hip Hop artist and producer TOIL.<ref>[https://youtu.be/byLHbKv489U?t=42 킹겐의 50문 50답] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on May 23, 2025.
** The 33rd player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK.
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on August 09, 2025, becoming the 21st player to do so.

{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
